faq.q: What is a GLP-1 exit strategy?
faq.a: The education and habit plan built before the last dose of a GLP-1 medication, so the patterns that raised your weight are not waiting at the finish line. On average, people regain two-thirds of lost weight within a year of stopping (Wilding et al., 2021, NEJM). Educational only; never change medication without your prescriber.
The Metabolic Clarity Kit is free. Platform memberships run $37 to $997 per month. Private 1-on-1 educational engagements start with a $349 Supplement Stack Audit.
